entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The vampire parun (founder) of House Dimir and first Mind Drinker vampire.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Aided Szadek in nearly destroying the Guildpact.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Arrested Szadek; later a ghost and Szadek's warden.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: Killed Szadek and enslaved his ghost; later killed by Szadek.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild whose prisons held Szadek.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: The guild whose angels Szadek was sent to kill.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Boros skyship to which Szadek was sent.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: A district Szadek took over, fused with Ravnica.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event that dissolved the ghost-world anomaly.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: Period in which Kos threw a grounder with Szadek's spirit.

events.summary: Szadek attacks the Decamillennial ceremony with his lupul and Savra and nearly destroys the Guildpact.

events.quote: he was arrested by Agrus Kos for crimes against the Guildpact

events.summary: Augustin IV kills Szadek in Azorius prisons and enslaves his ghost.
events.quote: killed him and enslaved his ghost

events.summary: Szadek is sent to Parhelion to kill the Boros angels and Razia.
events.quote: He then sent Szadek to Parhelion to kill the Boros angels

events.summary: Szadek breaks out of the grounder and kills Augustin by removing his soul.
events.quote: Szadek broke out of the container and killed Augustin by removing his soul.

events.summary: Szadek is revealed to have taken over Agyrem; Kos is appointed his warden.
events.quote: Kos, now a ghost himself, was appointed as his warden

events.summary: The Mending dissolves the ghost-world anomaly and the trapped spirits pass on.
events.quote: the trapped spirits were able to pass on to the aether

events.summary: Lazav claims to have contacted Szadek's spirit and used it to reestablish House Dimir.
events.quote: Lazav , the new guildmaster of House Dimir, claims to have contacted Szadek's spirit
